The histogram sums to 531279 exterior points and its weighted sum is 28952154; including 159516 incidences on the curve gives 29111670=39879*730. It has min 25 at 1512 and max 222 at 63, the latter all F9-subplane exterior centers. Independently recalculated every histogram checksum and reviewed both finite algorithms; the expensive complete C++ runs were NOT rerun in this audit, so this C determination rests on the inspected complete exhaustive code and exact mathematical counting specification rather than a newly executed full census.
